description: The module is a comprehensive suite of FIPS Approved and non-Approved algorithms and delivered to the end customer(s) as a Dynamically Linked Library (DLL) which is the logical boundary of the cryptographic module. The module provides cryptographic functionalities in Motorola Solutions ASTRO IP Dispatch Console products.
